fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists a strategy as being designed or awaiting adoption: NSDS (successor to NSDS 2018-2022).

The Ghana Statistical Service held a workshop with chief directors and heads of public-sector institutions on 18 March 2026 to validate NSDS III (2026-2030), built on three pillars: integration, interoperability and data use; no adoption is stated.
The 2026 budget allocates GH¢207 million to rebase GDP and the consumer price index, aligned with the upcoming NSDS III, which will cover 2026-2030.
